key_insight: ArchSpace aims to make LLM architecture research easier to record, review, and reference. The supplied abstract is incomplete, so specific implementation details and findings are not available.
problem_solved: Architecture decisions affect scaling, training efficiency, and inference cost, but industry reports often omit failed ideas and decision rationales. Academic studies face limited compute and inconsistent baselines, making architectural comparisons difficult.
method: Record architecture research and design decisions—the scope indicated by the title.
Review architectural ideas and their evaluation context.
Reference prior research to support future architecture decisions.
impact: More transparent architecture research could help practitioners learn from past experiments and assess trade-offs more reliably. The excerpt does not establish measured benefits.
visual_elements: Architecture trade-off triangle: scaling, training efficiency, and inference cost.
Industry–academia comparison showing reporting gaps versus compute and baseline constraints.
Experiment-history timeline highlighting successful, abandoned, and unresolved ideas.
paper_title: ArchSpace: Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing LLM Architecture Research
paper_authors: Jie Wang, Tong Zhu, JiaHao Kuang, Zhe Xu, Yunkai Chai
